content.text: from them shall proceed the judgment of these, and the captivity of these
the supping up of their faces, etc.
their faces shall look toward the East
the opposition of their faces toward the East
thou upon them that deal treacherously,
all of them with the angle,
for it; because it will surely
shall not all these take up

content: not his! how long? and to him that ladeth

content.text: thee, and thou shalt be for booties
unto him that giveth his neighbour
more with shame then with glory
thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered:
be silent all the earth before him
bright beams out of his side
thou didst cleave the rivers of the earth
thine arrows walked in the light
They came out as a whirlwind

content: And he will make me to walk
